quest.title: The Blessings of The Seven
quest.description: Paimon suggests you go to a Statue of The Seven.

talks.objective: Obtained the first Statue's Eye of Wind
Go to the Statue of The Seven in Windrise

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can you feel the blessings of The Seven?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Keep offering Anemoculi, and maybe you'll receive more blessings!

talks.objective: Offer the Anemoculus to the Statue

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can you feel the blessings of The Seven?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In Mondstadt, people refer to the consolidated wind as Anemoculi.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're called this because they can be fitted into the statue's eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Some fairy tales say the statues' eyes originally had gems that were taken by swallows.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Anemoculi never had a physical form from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: People with Visions collect them to offer to the statues in exchange for blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unlike others with powers, you don't have a Vision. But then the rules of this world don't apply to you anyway so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Keep offering Anemoculi, and maybe you'll receive more blessings!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a Statue of The Seven!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's make an offering and see if the gods respond!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's one of those consolidated wind thingies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's head back to the Statue of The Seven at Windrise and offer it to the gods!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... You should come with me, Paimon'll tell you about the rest later.
